ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced protruding mass of barnacle clusters at the extreme distal point of the left fluke lobe.
